description: Create an outbound webhook endpoint. The response includes a signingSecret that is returned only once; it is needed to verify webhook signatures and cannot be retrieved later. If events is omitted, a default set of event types is subscribed.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. If omitted, a default set is used. email.received (new mail to inbox addresses and receiving domains, not replies to your emails; not sent for spam) is opt-in: list it explicitly.

url.description: HTTPS URL that will receive webhook events.

name: create_webhook

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_webhook` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

webhook.description: The outbound webhook record returned by Sequenzy.
